EXEMPLO DE REGISTRO REAL (estudo de caso) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- { "cve_id": "CVE-2026-20978", "published": "2026-02-04", "cna": "Samsung Mobile", "cwe": ["CWE-269"], "cvss_v4": 5.8, "cvss_v3": 6.1, "attack_vector": "LOCAL", "privileges_required": "LOW", "user_interaction": "NONE", "impact_conf": "NONE", "impact_integ": "HIGH", "impact_avail": "LOW", "epss": 0.00131, "in_kev": false, "affected_cpes": [ "cpe:2.3:o:samsung:android:13.0", "cpe:2.3:o:samsung:android:14.0", "cpe:2.3:o:samsung:android:15.0", "cpe:2.3:o:samsung:android:16.0" ], "fixed_in": "SMR Feb-2026 Release 1", "description": "Improper authorization in KnoxGuardManager prior to SMR Feb-2026 Release 1 allows local attackers to bypass the persistence configuration of the application." } Leitura técnica do caso: - AV:L + PR:L => exige posição local e privilégios já obtidos.
Não é RCE.
- VI:H => o impacto real é sobre INTEGRIDADE/configuração do componente.
- EPSS ~0.001 => exploração em massa improvável; prioridade baixa.
- Sem KEV => nenhum exploit confirmado in-the-wild até a consulta.
Conclusão que um LLM deveria produzir: "patch de rotina, aplicar no próximo ciclo, sem urgência operacional".

INGESTÃO: CÓDIGO DE COLETA -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- import gzip, json, httpx def fetch_nvd_recent(url: str) -> list[dict]: with httpx.stream("GET", url, timeout=120, follow_redirects=True) as r: r.raise_for_status() raw = b"".join(r.iter_bytes()) data = json.loads(gzip.decompress(raw)) out = [] for item in data.get("vulnerabilities", []): c = item["cve"] m = {d["type"]: d["value"] for d in c.get("metrics", {}).get( "cvssMetricV31", [])[:1]} out.append(c) return out def fetch_epss(cve_ids: list[str]) -> dict[str, float]: ids = ",".join(cve_ids) r = httpx.get(f"https://api.first.org/data/v1/epss?cve={ids}", timeout=60) r.raise_for_status() return {d["cve"]: float(d["epss"]) for d in r.json().get("data", [])} Observações: - NVD limita taxa de requisição; use intervalo de 6s sem API key.
- Guarde o payload bruto (auditoria + reprodutibilidade do dataset).

RETRIEVAL (RAG) SOBRE DESCRIÇÕES -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer import numpy as np enc = SentenceTransformer("all-MiniLM-L6-v2") def build_index(records: list[dict]) -> np.ndarray: texts = [f'{r["cve_id"]} | {",".join(r["cwe"])} | {r["description"]}' for r in records] return enc.encode(texts, normalize_embeddings=True) def top_k(query: str, index: np.ndarray, records: list[dict], k: int = 8): q = enc.encode([query], normalize_embeddings=True)[0] scores = index @ q # cosseno (embeddings normalizados) idx = np.argsort(-scores)[:k] return [{"score": float(scores[i]), **records[i]} for i in idx] Por que RAG aqui: - O LLM não "sabe" CVEs recentes; o retrieval injeta os registros corretos.
- Reduz alucinação de versões/IDs: o modelo cita o que está no contexto.
- Permite atualizar o conhecimento sem retreinar o modelo.

exploração provável / confirmada elif cvss >= 7.0 and epss >= 0.01: tier = "P2" elif cvss >= 7.0: tier = "P3" else: tier = "P4" return {"tier": tier, "rationale": f"cvss={cvss} epss={epss} kev={in_kev}"} Loop de orquestração (pseudo-código compatível com SDKs de tool calling): def run_agent(user_msg: str, client, model: str, max_steps: int = 6): msgs = [ {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT}, {"role": "user", "content": user_msg}, ] for _ in range(max_steps): resp = client.chat.completions.create( model=model, messages=msgs, tools=tools, tool_choice="auto", temperature=0.0) m = resp.choices[0].message msgs.append(m.model_dump(exclude_none=True)) if not m.tool_calls: return m.content for tc in m.tool_calls: args = json.loads(tc.function.arguments) fn = {"lookup_cve": lookup_cve, "patch_status": patch_status, "prioritize": prioritize}[tc.function.name] msgs.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tc.id, "content": json.dumps(fn(**args))}) return "limite de passos atingido" Pontos críticos: - temperature=0.0 para análise factual.
- Sempre valide `arguments` com Pydantic antes de executar.
- Nunca deixe o LLM escrever SQL/shell direto; exponha só funções tipadas.

FORMATO DE PACOTE SSH (RFC 4253 - SECAO 6) ================================================================================ Estrutura de um pacote SSH: uint32 packet_length (BIG-ENDIAN) byte padding_length byte[] payload (packet_length - padding_length - 1 bytes) byte[] random_padding (padding_length bytes) REGRAS: - packet_length = tamanho do (padding_length + payload + padding) - padding total deve deixar o pacote multiplo do block size (8 sem cripto) - padding_length deve ser >= 4 - TODOS os numeros sao BIG-ENDIAN (network byte order) ================================================================================ 2.

SSH exige Big-Endian -> inverter $b = [BitConverter]::GetBytes($Val) if ([BitConverter]::IsLittleEndian) { [Array]::Reverse($b) } [void]$List.AddRange($b) } -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 2.2 ESCREVER STRING SSH (uint32 length + bytes) - RFC 4251 SECAO 5 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function Write-String { param([System.Collections.ArrayList]$List, [string]$Val) $b = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($Val) Write-Uint32 -List $List -Val $b.Length [void]$List.AddRange($b) } -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 2.3 EMPACOTAR PACOTE COMPLETO (Packetize) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function Packetize { param([byte[]]$Payload) $r = New-Object System.Random $bodyLen = 1 + $Payload.Length # +1 = padding_length byte $pad = 8 - ($bodyLen % 8) # multiplo de 8 (sem cripto) if ($pad -lt 4) { $pad += 8 } # padding minimo = 4 $totalLen = $bodyLen + $pad $pkt = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList $lb = [BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]$totalLen) if ([BitConverter]::IsLittleEndian) { [Array]::Reverse($lb) } [void]$pkt.AddRange($lb) # packet_length (4 bytes BE) [void]$pkt.Add([byte]$pad) # padding_length (1 byte) [void]$pkt.AddRange($Payload) # payload for ($i = 0; $i -lt $pad; $i++) { # padding aleatorio [void]$pkt.Add([byte]$r.Next(1,256)) } return $pkt.ToArray() } -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 2.4 ENVIO NO STREAM TCP -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function Send-Raw { param($Stream, [byte[]]$Data) if (-not $Stream.CanWrite -or $Data.Length -eq 0) { return } try { $Stream.Write($Data, 0, $Data.Length) # SEMPRE 3 argumentos: $Stream.Flush() # (array, offset, count) } catch { Write-Host "Erro: $_" } } ERRO COMUM: $Stream.Write($bytes) # ERRADO - sobrecarga inexistente $Stream.Write($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length) # CORRETO ================================================================================ 3.

MENSAGENS PRINCIPAIS - CONSTRUCAO ================================================================================ -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 5.1 KEXINIT (tipo 20) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function Make-KexInit { param([string]$KexAlgos, [string]$KeyAlgos, [string]$EncAlgos, [string]$MacAlgos) $r = New-Object System.Random $k = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList [void]$k.Add([byte]20) # msg_type for ($i = 0; $i -lt 16; $i++) { # cookie 16 bytes aleatorios [void]$k.Add([byte]$r.Next(0,256)) } # 10 name-lists na ordem exata (RFC 4253 secao 7.1): Write-String -List $k -Val $KexAlgos # kex_algorithms Write-String -List $k -Val $KeyAlgos # server_host_key_algorithms Write-String -List $k -Val $EncAlgos # enc c2s Write-String -List $k -Val $EncAlgos # enc s2c Write-String -List $k -Val $MacAlgos # mac c2s Write-String -List $k -Val $MacAlgos # mac s2c Write-String -List $k -Val "none" # compression c2s Write-String -List $k -Val "none" # compression s2c Write-String -List $k -Val "" # languages c2s Write-String -List $k -Val "" # languages s2c [void]$k.Add([byte]0) # first_kex_packet_follows $z = New-Object byte[] 4 # reserved (uint32 = 0) [void]$k.AddRange($z) return $k.ToArray() } Exemplo de chamada compativel com Cisco IOS: Make-KexInit -KexAlgos "diffie-hellman-group14-sha1" ` -KeyAlgos "ssh-rsa" ` -EncAlgos "aes128-cbc" ` -MacAlgos "hmac-sha1" -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 5.2 KEXDH_INIT (tipo 30) - FORMATO MPINT (RFC 4251) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- mpint = uint32 length + valor big-endian, sem zeros a esquerda desnecessarios, bit de sinal preservado.

function Make-KexDhInit { param([System.Numerics.BigInteger]$PublicKey) $i = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList [void]$i.Add([byte]30) # BigInteger.ToByteArray() = little-endian + byte de sinal $b = $PublicKey.ToByteArray() [Array]::Reverse($b) # converte para big-endian # Remove zeros a esquerda (mantendo bit de sinal correto) while ($b.Length -gt 1 -and $b[0] -eq 0 -and ($b[1] -band 0x80) -eq 0) { $b = $b[1..($b.Length-1)] } $lb = [BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]$b.Length) if ([BitConverter]::IsLittleEndian) { [Array]::Reverse($lb) } [void]$i.AddRange($lb) [void]$i.AddRange($b) return $i.ToArray() } -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 5.3 GERACAO DE CHAVES DH (Group14 = primo de 2048 bits) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Group14 p (hex, RFC 3526): ver secao 7 deste documento.
Gerador g = 2.

$rng = New-Object System.Security.Cryptography.RNGCryptoServiceProvider $privBytes = New-Object byte[] 256 # entropia proporcional $rng.GetBytes($privBytes) $privBytes[$privBytes.Length - 1] = $privBytes[$privBytes.Length - 1] -band 0x7F $privateKey = [System.Numerics.BigInteger]::new($privBytes) if ($privateKey -le 1) { $privateKey = 2 } $gen = [System.Numerics.BigInteger]::new(2) $publicKey = [System.Numerics.BigInteger]::ModPow($gen, $privateKey, $prime) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 5.4 CHANNEL_OPEN (tipo 90) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function Make-ChannelOpen { param([int]$SenderChan = 1) $c = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList [void]$c.Add([byte]90) Write-String -List $c -Val "session" # channel type Write-Uint32 -List $c -Val $SenderChan # sender channel Write-Uint32 -List $c -Val 65536 # initial window size Write-Uint32 -List $c -Val 65536 # maximum packet size return $c.ToArray() } -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 5.5 CHANNEL_REQUEST "exec" (tipo 98) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function Make-ChannelRequestExec { param([int]$Channel, [string]$Command) $e = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList [void]$e.Add([byte]98) Write-Uint32 -List $e -Val $Channel # recipient channel Write-String -List $e -Val "exec" # request type [void]$e.Add([byte]1) # want_reply = true Write-String -List $e -Val $Command # comando return $e.ToArray() } ================================================================================ 6.

PARSING DE RESPOSTAS ================================================================================ -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 6.1 LEITURA COM TIMEOUT (nao trava) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function Read-All { param($Stream, [int]$TimeoutMs = 3000) $b = New-Object byte[] 65536 $a = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew() $gotData = $false try { do { if ($Stream.DataAvailable) { $n = $Stream.Read($b, 0, $b.Length) if ($n -gt 0) { [void]$a.AddRange($b[0..($n-1)]) $gotData = $true $sw.Restart() # reseta timer a cada dado } } Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50 } while ($sw.ElapsedMilliseconds -lt $TimeoutMs) } catch {} if (-not $gotData) { return $null } return $a.ToArray() } -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 6.2 LEITURA DE UINT32 BIG-ENDIAN DE UM BUFFER -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function Read-BytesBE { param([byte[]]$Data, [int]$Start, [int]$Count) if ($Start + $Count -gt $Data.Length) { return $null } $b = New-Object byte[] $Count [Array]::Copy($Data, $Start, $b, 0, $Count) if ([BitConverter]::IsLittleEndian) { [Array]::Reverse($b) } return $b } -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 6.3 PARSER DE PACOTES MULTIPLOS EM UM BUFFER -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Um buffer pode conter varios pacotes concatenados (TCP coalescing).
